title: Add Audio Player
content: Create audio player. Container: flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-gray-100 rounded-lg. Play button: w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-blue-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center, play/pause icon. Progress: flex-1, slider input type="range" styled, show current time / duration. Volume: volume icon button, slider on hover/click. Waveform: optional visual representation.

variants.simple: Create custom audio player with controls.
variants.detailed: Create audio player. Container: flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-gray-100 rounded-lg. Play button: w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-blue-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center, play/pause icon. Progress: flex-1, slider input type="range" styled, show current time / duration. Volume: volume icon button, slider on hover/click. Waveform: optional visual representation.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive audio player. Layout options: minimal (just controls), standard (with waveform), full (with playlist). Playback controls: play/pause, skip back 10s, skip forward 10s, previous/next track. Progress bar: custom range input, current position indicator, buffered range shown, click/drag to seek, hover shows time tooltip. Time display: current / total, toggle to show remaining. Volume: icon (muted/low/medium/high), slider popup or inline, mute toggle, remember preference. Waveform: visualize audio waveform using Web Audio API, highlight played portion, click to seek. Speed control: 0.5x, 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x. Playlist mode: queue of tracks, current playing highlighted, drag to reorder, remove from queue. Track info: cover art, title, artist, album. Keyboard shortcuts: Space play/pause, arrow keys seek, M mute, up/down volume. Mini player: minimized view that persists across navigation. Accessibility: all controls labeled, keyboard navigable, announce track changes. Mobile: larger touch targets, gesture controls. Background play: continue when tab not focused. Media session: integrate with OS media controls (lock screen, etc).
